sloka: प्रतिजग्मुश्च ता नद्यो गन्धर्वाश्च यथागतम् ।भरद्वाजमनुज्ञाप्य ताश्च सर्वा वराङ्गना: ॥ २.९१.८२॥
transliteration: pratijagmuśca tā nadyo gandharvāśca yathāgatam ।bharadvājamanujñāpya tāśca sarvā varāṅganā: ॥ 2.91.82॥

translations.english: As they were enjoying themselves in Bharadwaja's hermitage like the gods in the garden of Indra the night wore off.
